tables.name: Disposition
tables.description: The prevailing attitude of residents toward visitors.

results.name: Hostile
results.description: Locals seem very unfriendly toward visitors, and would likely make out-of-towners feel unwelcome. This could manifest as coldness, passive-aggressiveness, or even violence.

results.name: Unfriendly
results.description: Locals don’t care much for visitors, looking upon them with contempt, fear, or suspicion.

results.name: Neutral
results.description: Locals are standoffish, or perhaps hard on the outside, but can be friendly, if you get to know them.

results.name: Friendly
results.description: Locals are generally friendly, welcoming, and slow to take offense.

results.name: Open
results.description: The locals actively enjoy visitors, and their culture incorporates this. Just about anyone is welcome.
